1879064075.name: Sprint
1879064075.desc: Increases movement speed.\n\nGrants immunity to movement speed debuffs.

1879064203.name: Story of Courage
1879064203.desc: Removes one Poison, Fear, Disease, or Wound from nearby fellows.\n\nProtects against further Fears.

1879064331.name: Gambler's Advantage
1879064331.desc: A Critical hit enables the Burglar to strike from an advantageous position, applying a tiering bleed to the target.

1879073675.name: Jagged Cut
1879073675.desc: A sweeping cut that can damage multiple targets in front of you.

1879099275.name: Mentor: Horn
1879099275.desc: You can instruct someone how to play the horn.

1879111435.name: Adamant
1879111435.desc: Champions shrug off damage that would bring many to their knees.

1879146123.name: Improved Warding Knowledge
1879146123.desc:
Creates a circle in which enemies are vulnerable to tactical damage and more likely to miss.

Circle remains for 1 minute.

Affects the following:
Dead, Unseen, Creatures of Nature, Insects and additionally affects  Men, Dwarves, Orc-kind, Beasts, and Trolls.

1879153291.name: Javelin of Deadly Force - Light
1879153291.desc:
With preparation, some Wardens can throw their javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.

For every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.

With the appropriate Assailment traits, this javelin will apply the Marked and Diminished Target debuffs to any targets hit.
This skill is not influenced by modifiers to Max Range.

1879198347.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Deep-wood Sabre-cat)
1879198347.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879202187.name: Athelas Healing
1879202187.desc: Soldiers of Minas Ithil carry packets of athelas with them for healing purposes during combat. Can be used on oneself or thrown to an ally.

1879213323.name: Shield and Shield
1879213323.desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879214603.name: Offensive Strike
1879214603.desc: A swift double attack.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879231371.name: Ranged Reversal
1879231371.desc: Deals heavy damage and removes one corruption from the enemy.

1879238667.name: Dash
1879238667.desc: Your steed pushes itself beyond normal limits, maintaining an increased speed for as long as its power holds out.

1879239563.name: Kill Shot
1879239563.desc: Targeting the most vital areas of an opponent is difficult enough. While mounted it takes increased skill and effort; maybe even a little patience and luck, but when you strike with this skill the results are destructive.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This skill has a reduced chance to hit unless the trait Shoot to Kill is active.</rgb>

1879241995.name: Serrated Edge
1879241995.desc: The initial impact of your weapon is meant to injure your foe, but the true damage is unleashed as you drag your weapon across your foe's flesh.

1879243915.name: Improved Bracing Attack
1879243915.desc: You make an attack which allows you to brace yourself against counterattack, increasing your Morale by a small amount. Your Morale will increase even if this attack is avoided.

1879248011.name: Quick Spear-toss
1879248011.desc: You quickly throw the spear in the direction of the target. It is not likely to strike.

1879260043.name: Burning Arrow
1879260043.desc: Your oil-soaked arrow sets your enemy aflame and causes it to burn.

1879263627.name: Lay Trap
1879263627.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879307147.name: Plain Shrew
1879307147.desc: Summons a plain shrew to brighten your day.

1879315083.name: Rending Blow
1879315083.desc: You strike your opponent across the face with your paw, interrupting their action.

1879332619.name: Skittish Black Horse
1879332619.desc: Summons a horse with a jet-black coat to keep you company.

1879342475.name: Steed of the Moon Moth
1879342475.desc: A steed evoking the beauty of the moth.

1879344395.name: Harvestmath Pony
1879344395.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879367947.name: Set Trap
1879367947.desc: Places a trap to root the enemy.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879387659.name: Orange Glow Worm
1879387659.desc: Brings out an orange glow worm to keep you company.

1879387787.name: Steed of the Unearthed Kingdom
1879387787.desc: A steed inspired by the ancient kingdom of Khazad-dûm.

1879391243.name: Steed of the Wild Hills
1879391243.desc: A steed inspired by the Wild Hills of Enedwaith.

1879408139.name: Purple Firefly
1879408139.desc: Summons a purple firefly to keep you company.

1879417099.name: Tame Wildwood Huorn
1879417099.desc: Summons a Wildwood huorn so you never leave the forest behind.

1879449995.name: Bash (Dual)
1879449995.desc: A savage attack that leaves your target bleeding.

1879457547.name: Spear of Fate
1879457547.desc: A lunge which deals shorter, more potent Light damage over time.

1879466251.name: Belly of Brine
1879466251.desc: Minor afflictions don't compare to eating only rations for long periods. Your strong stomach allows you to shrug off a single effect.

1879467275.name: Carry Caber - Slow
1879467275.desc: You carry a caber, slowly, showing your strength as a forester.

1879468683.name: Fennec Fox
1879468683.desc: Summons a curious fennec fox to accompany you on your journeys.

1879483531.name: Punishing Blow
1879483531.desc: A powerful attack that can only be used on opponents under 20% health.

1879489163.name: Heavy Slam
1879489163.desc: Your companion throws their bulk at their target, stunning them.

1879500427.name: Glorfindel's Aid
1879500427.desc:
Call upon Glorfindel to empower his Elf-stone to purge the essence of the void seeping into Middle-earth.
<rgb=#00FF00>Destroys active blisters around you.</rgb>

To use this skill, you must be near Glorfindel.

1879502731.name: Terror of the Sands
1879502731.desc: Summons a loving but terrifying bird to accompany you on your adventures.

1879506827.name: Clash of Arms
1879506827.desc: Smash your target as if caught between a hammer and anvil.

1879521291.name: Desert Slime
1879521291.desc: Summons a desert slime to accompany you on your travels.

1879527435.name: Delothlin Gem
1879527435.desc: Channel the power of the gem to cleanse the target of the TBD Curse. This power will also harm the user.
